name: Facial Boundary Frequency
description: Analyzes facial boundary 频率 content
algorithm: Facial Boundary Frequency — Frequency Domain Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes frequency characteristics at facial boundaries for deepfake detection:

1. **边界区域提取**: The boundary zone between the face and surrounding content (hair, neck, background) is extracted as a narrow strip. This boundary is where face-swap blending produces the most detectable frequency-domain artifacts.

2. **局部频率分析**: Spatial frequency content in the boundary strip is analyzed via localized 2D FFT or wavelet transforms. The frequency characteristics on the face side vs. the background side of the boundary are compared. Different generation/capture pipelines produce different frequency signatures.

3. **频率TransitionProfiling**: The transition of frequency content across the boundary is measured. Natural face boundaries show smooth frequency transitions. Deepfake blending creates characteristic frequency discontinuities — typically a high-frequency step (different noise levels) or spectral notch (frequency content removed by low-pass blending).

4. **Periodic伪影检测**: The method specifically searches for periodic frequency artifacts at the boundary that arise from: (a) resampling/interpolation during face alignment, (b) GAN generator architecture (checkerboard patterns from transposed convolutions), (c) encoder-decoder quantization in autoencoder-based face swaps.

5. **Multi-方向频率Scanning**: The boundary frequency content is analyzed at multiple orientations. Natural boundaries show orientation-dependent frequency content (hair has directional texture, skin is more isotropic). Deepfake boundaries may show unnatural frequency isotropy or orientation-dependent artifacts from the blending direction.
parameters:
分析类型: 频率
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through facial boundary 频率 analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
